desktopNotSupported: This app is designed for mobile devices.
installAppDescription: Add this app to your home screen.
installAppUnavailable: Use your browser menu, then “Add to Home Screen”.
updateAppDescription: Fetch the newest version and reload.
appLockDescription: Ask for your fingerprint before opening.
appLockUnsupported: No fingerprint unlock on this device.
appLockFailed: Setting up the lock did not work.
unlockFailed: That did not work. Try again.
eraseDataWarningDescription: Your data is encrypted and can only be read with a working fingerprint unlock. Since that isn't available right now, turning off the lock permanently erases it — there is no way to recover it afterwards.
emptyDescription: Tap + to write a note or start a checklist.
title: Title
deleteNoteDescription: It's deleted for good — there's no trash.
noteNotFound: This note doesn't exist any more.
appLockNotice: A convenience lock only — it does not encrypt your notes.
appLockEncryptedNotice: Your notes are encrypted with a key derived from your fingerprint. If it stops working, your notes cannot be recovered — export a backup as insurance.
restoreDescription: Bring back the notes saved before the last update.
updateConfirmDescription: The app reloads. Your notes are backed up first.
exportDataDescription: Save a backup file of all your notes.
importDataDescription: Add the notes from a backup file to yours.
importFailed: That file isn't a notes backup.
importDescription: Notes missing from this device are added. A note that is in both keeps its newer version. Nothing is deleted.
